notes: Bosch 800 Plus series built-in dishwasher, North American 120 V 60 Hz version. The service manual covers a multi-market platform and marks several parts optional (aqua sensor, water switch, water storage tank, heat exchanger), and the owner's manual describes no water softener, so check which parts this unit has.

gaps: The service manual prints no model list. The link to the SHX68T55UC is the Internet Archive item (titled 800 Plus Series, described as the manual and service manual for SHX68T55UC/07), whose owner's manual lists SHX68T5xUC*.
The test tables give EU, USA and TC columns; the USA or TC / USA values are used (the heater test also prints an EU value).
The heating pump winding test prints a second, unlabelled 12 to 14 ohm value; it is not claimed.
No volts or watts are printed for the heater, the heating pump or the drain pump, so none are set.
The manual shows an Aquastop valve and a plain water inlet valve; the coil figures are the Aquastop test, and which valve this unit has is not shown.

Optional or regional parts (aqua sensor, water switch, water storage tank valve, heat exchanger flow sensor) and the softener regeneration valve are not tied to this model by any source; the owner's manual describes no softener, salt or tank.
The source writes decimals with a comma (2,67 kOhm); they are given here with a point.
The manual is dated 07.02.13 and covers several markets; the English North American values are used.
method: Bosch service manual (document 155_58300000157604_ara_en_c, dated 07.02.13, 189 pages), Internet Archive copy, read with research.js pdf and pdftotext.
Internet Archive item page: title 'Bosch 800 Plus Series Dishwasher Manuals', description 'Manual and service manual for Bosch SHX68T55UC/07 800 series dishwasher'.
Owner's manual for SHX68T55UC-07 in the same item: the model table on PDF page 6 lists SHX68T5xUC* (x is any number or letter).
Service manual pages used: 11, 16, 21, 31 to 37, 62, 90, 92 to 98 and 189 (supply voltage by market; the UC row is 120 V 60 Hz).
Bosch's own support pages, PartSelect and Sears PartsDirect were not used for values.

comps.spec: Heating pump, the circulation pump: a brushless DC motor with the heater tube and two NTCs in one housing. Winding about 41.5 ohms +/-4 or about 53.5 ohms +/-4.5 ohms, depending on the maker (25 C)
comps.loc: Pump sump (the heating pump is fitted in the sump)

comps.spec: Drain pump with a brushless DC motor and impeller: winding about 80.5 ohms +/-5 ohms

Heater in the heating pump: about 8.9 ohms +/-2 ohms across contacts 2 and 3 (TC/USA; about 19 ohms EU). Two NTCs in the tube, about 10 kilohms each at 25 C. The heating tube cannot be replaced separately
comps.loc: Heating tube inside the heating pump, in the pump sump

comps.spec: Aqua sensor (optional turbidity sensor): an infrared diode and a phototransistor facing each other across a U-shaped housing on a board; reads turbidity in the prewash, wash and end of wash

Flow sensor in the water channel of the heat exchanger (the manual lists the heat exchanger as optional): an impeller with a small magnet and a reed switch; the control counts the pulses to calculate the water let in
Door sensor: a Hall element at the centre top of the inner door; a magnet in the door lock sits over it when the door is closed
Aquastop valve (inlet valve in a safety housing): coil 110 to 127 V 60 Hz, about 990 ohms +/-50 ohms (TC/USA values); the manual also shows a plain water inlet valve
Aquastop float: a polystyrene float trips a micro-switch, and the control then de-energises the Aquastop coil to stop the water
Water softener regeneration valve, a 2-way valve in the softening system: coil 120 to 127 V 60 Hz, about 660 ohms +/-10 % (USA values)
Water storage tank valve (optional, PTC actuator): coil 110 to 240 V 50/60 Hz, 800 to 1,200 ohms at 20 C

Water switch drive motor, which selects the three spray levels and the tank fill, with a cam plate and pulse generator: 120 V 50/60 Hz, 5 W, 5.9 kilohms +/-800 ohms or 4.7 kilohms +/-800 ohms (TC/USA values)
Dispenser coil (USA values): pulse of 165 V DC, about 2.67 kilohms +/-210 ohms; rinse aid capacity 80 ml
Power module, the main electronics: relays for pump reversal, the heater and security, an inrush current limiter and a varistor; the dispenser coil is driven from it
Relays on the power module: K201 and K202 reverse the circulation and drain pumps, K303 and K305 switch the heater (K305 for the zeolite heater), K301 and K100 are security relays
